source_note: Public datasets-server rows responses do not bind a revision in their request URL. Exact input content is frozen by the local response hash and per-prompt hashes, not inferred solely from the repository SHA.

selection.rule: exact-clean-text deduplicate; sort by character length then row_idx; partition into 3 equal-count strata; within each select 4 smallest SHA256(seed + NUL + clean_prompt); no model outputs used

sham.rule: Fixed once without testing model behavior; no trigger search.
